description: Enable, disable, or configure the auto-response email sent to people who submit a form. Requires an API key — call instant_provision first, or set FORMSLIST_API_KEY. Auto-responses are a paid-plan feature: if the account's plan does not include them, the result contains the upgrade message and upgrade_url to relay to the user.

body_html.description: HTML body of the auto-response email

enabled.description: Whether the auto-response email is enabled

from_name.description: Sender display name for the auto-response email

subject.description: Subject line of the auto-response email

name: configure_autoresponse
